a: A canvas-stack loupe never resamples its color while the stack animates under a still aim
`<SourceLoupe>` reads its `CanvasSource` without retaining it, so a captured (WebGL) source is blank when used on its own
`<LoupeGestures>` registers on the camera's registry for the first commit even when its host is not the camera's element, and the "two loupes" warning fires falsely
A `render` loupe falling back to the camera, and a `sceneView` lens with a thunk view, read the camera once per React render, and nothing re-renders them when it moves
b: Live clone lens shows a scrolled scroller inside the trial at scroll position 0
Live clone lens goes stale on input that doesn't change the DOM
A clone copy's box keeps the root's old size and offset after a DOM change resizes or moves the root
LoupeGestures registers a non-camera-host loupe on the camera's registry for its first commit, causing a false two-loupe warning and possibly removing a sibling's actions
